member.name: T:RoverLink.Telemetry.FrameCodec
member.summary:
Wire codec for the RoverLink RL-100 link.
Telemetry frames (rover to station) are 37 bytes and begin with the ASCII marker "RL". Command frames (station to rover) are 10 bytes and begin with "RC". Both are protected by a trailing CRC-8.
See RL-100 Integration Manual, revision D, section 4.
